rows.prelim_note: Tesla Q2 revenue ($28.2B) missed the $28.3B estimate and posted negative free cash flow; shares fell 14% — clears the revenue/cash-flow materiality criterion.

rows.headline: Alphabet and Tesla test Wall Street's patience as AI spending overshadows growth
rows.prelim_note: Alphabet raised its 2026 capex guidance to $195-205B from $180-190B despite a Q2 beat; shares fell 7% — a guidance change that shifts analyst expectations. Possible duplicate of INB-20260725-018 (same underlying event, different source).

rows.headline: Here's the Full List of Trump's New Tariffs on 60 Economies
rows.prelim_note: New Section 301 forced-labor tariffs of 10-12.5% took effect July 24, 2026 on 60 trading partners (incl. UK, Canada, India) as the prior 10% global tariff expired — a regulatory/trade-policy shift affecting supply/demand and margins broadly.

rows.headline: Oil Tankers Run the Houthi Gauntlet to Keep Saudi Exports Flowing
rows.prelim_note: Houthis attacked two named Saudi oil tankers (Encelia, Layla) in the Red Sea under a declared blockade; Brent topped $100/bbl for the first time since May — a supply-disruption risk to Gulf oil exports.

rows.headline: American Express Q2 2026 Earnings Press Release
rows.prelim_note: American Express beat Q2 EPS estimates ($4.53 vs $4.40) and raised its 2026 revenue growth forecast to 10% — a guidance raise that shifts analyst expectations.

rows.headline: Verizon Communications Q2 2026 Results
rows.prelim_note: Verizon beat postpaid-phone net-add estimates (184K vs 106K expected) and raised full-year guidance for a second consecutive quarter — clears the estimate-impact materiality criterion.

rows.headline: American Airlines (AAL) Q2 2026 earnings
rows.prelim_note: American Airlines beat Q2 EPS ($0.15 vs $0.03 est.) but cut FY26 guidance to roughly breakeven at the midpoint on a fuel-cost jump of ~$700M for Q3 and ~$1.6B for the rest of 2026; shares fell 7.8% — a guidance cut on a cash-flow driver.

rows.headline: Charter Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results
rows.prelim_note: Charter Q2 revenue fell 1.7% YoY, slightly below estimates, with continued broadband (-172K) and video (-21K) subscriber losses — a revenue/margin materiality criterion.

rows.headline: Jideytro (zidesamtinib) approved in the US for previously treated ROS1-positive non-small cell lung cancer
rows.prelim_note: FDA approved GSK's Jideytro (from the completed Nuvalent acquisition) on July 22, 2026, nearly two months ahead of its September PDUFA date, based on a 44% objective response rate in the ARROS-1 trial — a new revenue driver for GSK's oncology franchise.
